question: Which powers of Sadashiva are located on his sides and in his lap?
premises: In that world the god is Sadashiva.
Knowledge and action are on his left and right.
Supreme will is the power resting in his lap.
inference: Sadashiva's three powers are spatially arranged as knowledge, action, and supreme will.
plain_english: In that world the god is Sadashiva. Knowledge and action are on his left and right, while supreme will is the power resting in his lap.
